result.title: An Input Skip Can Reparameterize a VAE Without Improving the Generator
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM) Workshop. Available at: https://github.com/magnaprog/vae-skip-reparam
result.summary: An input skip can reduce reconstruction error while leaving a model's distribution of new samples unchanged. For a Gaussian variational autoencoder (VAE) with constant input skip $0\leqα<1$, a model without a skip can be written in skip form by multiplying its decoder output by $b=1-α$ and its noise variance by $b^2$. The distribution of observations and latent variables and its exact generative scores stay the same, while reconstruction mean squared error (MSE) is multiplied by $b^2$. Separate training can produce different generators because optimization depends on the parameter coordinates. In a Gaussian experiment with known density, changing skip and observation variance together reduces MSE but worsens energy score and the estimate of negative log density from importance sampling. On seven annual Deep-ocean Assessment and Reporting of Tsunamis (DART) records, energy score differences at the same observation variance have both signs on four original records and favor the skip on three records from 2018. Probabilistic principal component analysis (PPCA) has lower mean energy scores than every neural DART fit. With the encoder and decoder kept the same, estimating observation variance from training reconstruction error can also worsen energy score. Assessing generation requires more than reconstruction error.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出高斯 VAE 的常数输入 skip 可被等价重参数化：无 skip 模型可写成解码输出乘 b=1-α、噪声方差乘 b² 的 skip 形式，观测与 latent 分布及精确生成分数不变，但重构 MSE 乘 b²；并在已知密度的合成实验与七条 DART 记录上比较 energy score 与重要性采样估计的负对数密度。
AI.relevance_reason: 「重参数化只改重构误差而不改生成分布、评价生成不能只看重构误差」这一线索，可供核查 LVR 中用重构或探测指标推断 latent 内容是否被实际使用的做法是否可靠；但原文未涉及多模态推理与推理期状态生成，联系属方法层面。
